input.question: When was the Bonner House built?

documents.text: district Contributing property Show map of North Carolina Show map of the United States Location Front St., Bath, North Carolina Coordinates 35°28′20″N 76°48′49″W ﻿ / ﻿ 35.47222°N 76.81361°W ﻿ / 35.47222 ; -76.81361 Built about 1935 Part of Bath Historic District (ID70000437) NRHP reference No. 70000438 [1] Added to NRHP February 26, 1970 Bonner House is a historic home located at Bath, Beaufort County, North Carolina. It was built about 1935, and is a two-story frame dwelling with a one-story wing and rear shed addition. It sits on a prominent lot in the historic district, reflecting the architectural trends of the early 20th century.
